trajectory_summary: This is a short, cooperative, low-friction call that moves efficiently through verify items, captures a real bill figure, and lands a booked appointment with a day and time. The rep's pacing and tone matched a senior, slightly hard-of-hearing customer well, but the rep left two threads dangling — the mysterious 'grant' reference and the wife's role — that a closer will now have to untangle without warning.
